- tests/conftest.py:74-95 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The "Activate workspace shell context" step in review_autofix.yml (line 2844), implement.yml (line 1398), and validate.yml (line 567) exports GIT_DIR, GIT_WORK_TREE, and WORKSPACE_PATH into $GITHUB_ENV together. The conftest strips GIT_DIR and GIT_WORK_TREE from os.environ for the whole pytest session to prevent the editor's inherited environment from rebinding sandbox tests to the live checkout (documented for the #4092 incident). This PR makes review_untrusted_sandbox.sh prepare read and validate WORKSPACE_PATH against ${RUNNER_TEMP}/workspaces, but WORKSPACE_PATH is not in the conftest strip list. The existing test test_review_host_python_launches_are_isolated_and_broker_keeps_credential (tests/test_model_provider_broker.py:425) builds its env via env = os.environ.copy(), so when pytest runs inside the implement.yml editor (where WORKSPACE_PATH is set and the editor runs pytest for validation, as documented in the conftest docstring), the inherited WORKSPACE_PATH points at the real runner workspace while the test sets RUNNER_TEMP to its own short_dir. The new realpath -e validation in prepare (scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh:30-33) resolves ${RUNNER_TEMP}/workspaces to /invalid (the test's temp dir has no workspaces subdir), the dirname check fails, and prepare exits 1 with "Review workspace path rejected".
  WHY: The implement workflow's editor environment carries WORKSPACE_PATH (set by the same "Activate workspace shell context" step that sets GIT_DIR/GIT_WORK_TREE). When the editor runs pytest tests/test_model_provider_broker.py to validate its change, the existing test inherits WORKSPACE_PATH via os.environ.copy(), the new prepare validation rejects it because the test's RUNNER_TEMP doesn't match the real runner's workspaces root, and the test fails. This is the same class of environment-leak regression the conftest was created to prevent.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_2 ===
